- [LLEX.12.2] **Non-ASCII characters.** `UNIT_SUFFIX` admits seven in
  addition to ASCII letters, digits and `_` (continuation only,
  [LUNI.3.2]): `°` (U+00B0 DEGREE SIGN), `′` (U+2032 PRIME), `″` (U+2033 DOUBLE PRIME), `Ω` (U+03A9 GREEK CAPITAL
  LETTER OMEGA), `µ` (U+00B5 MICRO SIGN), `Å` (U+00C5 — ångström), and
  `ₙ` (U+2099 LATIN SUBSCRIPT SMALL LETTER N — for `gₙ`). No other
  non-ASCII characters are permitted.

  `ₙ` is a **continuation** character only: it may not begin a unit
  symbol ([LUNI.3.2]).

  The three plane-angle glyphs are ordinary suffix characters — there is
  no separate `ANGLE_GLYPH` set and no `attached` class ([LUNI.3.2.1]).
  They remain **Unicode-only**: ASCII `'` and `"` are not aliases for
  `′` and `″`, since `"` is the string delimiter.
